description: This file contains implementation of numeric conversion functions and a Fractional class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, including methods for digit and base conversions, and the Fractional class's constructors, destructor, and assignment operator.

classes.name: Fractional
classes.description: Represents a fractional number with an integer part and a remainder, providing constructors, destructor, and assignment operator.

methods.name: FromDigits
methods.description: Converts a character digit to its numeric value if valid.

methods.name: FromHexDigits
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal character to its numeric value.

methods.name: FromBase64
methods.description: Converts a Base64 character to its numeric value.

methods.name: FromDirect
methods.description: Returns the unsigned char value of a character.

methods.name: ToDigits
methods.description: Converts a numeric value to its character digit.

methods.name: ToHexDigits
methods.description: Converts a numeric value to its hexadecimal character.

methods.name: ToBase64
methods.description: Converts a numeric value to its Base64 character.

methods.name: ToDirect
methods.description: Returns the character representation of an unsigned char.
